# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  NOT INSTALLABLE VIA PIP — these come from the Raspberry Pi OS system packages
#
#      sudo apt install -y python3-picamera2 python3-kms++ python3-libcamera
#
#  and the virtualenv MUST be created so that it can see them:
#
#      python3 -m venv --system-site-packages yoloenv
#
#  A plain `python3 -m venv yoloenv` will fail to import picamera2, and the
#  resulting ModuleNotFoundError does not hint at the cause. This was one of
#  the longer-running setup problems in the project.
#
#  Do not attempt `pip install picamera2` — the pip package is not the same
#  thing as the system package and will not work with the Pi 5 camera stack.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
